verdict.rationale: Orama's pricing page calls it "the open-source search library" available at no cost, and the docs refer to an "Orama Open Source" edition. The source is hosted in the public oramasearch/orama GitHub repository, which also documents installing it from npm and other package managers. Missing for 10: the specific open license is never named in the evidence, and nothing shows whether the Orama Cloud and context-server components are open-source.
